name: African Walnut Solid Acoustic Slat Panels, Black Felt
summary: 100% solid African walnut slats on a black felt backing, sold as a two-panel box.

texture.note: No manufacturer spec sheet is published; the dimension diagram shows 8 slats per 12.6 in panel, giving a 1.575 in pitch, with photo-estimated 1.10 in faces, 0.475 in gaps and softly eased edges (0.60 in relief estimated within the recorded 0.83 in total thickness). Tile is 8 pitches wide and 25.2 in tall; dark African walnut tones are sampled from main.jpg with black felt backing, not the lighter gallery close-up.
